question: How many orders have been placed in total?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) AS orders FROM orders WHERE status <> 'cancelled'
notes: cancelled orders excluded from order counts

question: What is our total net revenue across all time?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(gross_amount - discount_amount - refund_amount), 2) AS net_revenue FROM orders WHERE status <> 'cancelled'

question: How many customers are registered?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) AS customers FROM customers

question: How many products are currently active?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) AS active_products FROM products WHERE is_active

question: What is the average order value (AOV) across all orders?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(gross_amount - discount_amount - refund_amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT order_id), 2) AS aov FROM orders WHERE status <> 'cancelled'

question: How many orders came through each sales channel?
gold_sql: SELECT channel, count(*) AS orders FROM orders WHERE status <> 'cancelled' GROUP BY channel ORDER BY orders DESC LIMIT 100

question: How many units have we sold in total?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(i.quantity) AS units_sold FROM order_items i JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled'

question: What are the top 5 product categories by units sold?
gold_sql: SELECT p.category, SUM(i.quantity) AS units FROM order_items i JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = i.product_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY units DESC, p.category LIMIT 5

question: Who are our top 5 customers by net revenue? Return customer ids and revenue.
gold_sql: SELECT o.customer_id, ROUND(SUM(o.gross_amount - o.discount_amount - o.refund_amount), 2) AS net_revenue FROM orders o WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' GROUP BY o.customer_id ORDER BY net_revenue DESC, o.customer_id LIMIT 5

question: What is net revenue by customer billing country?
gold_sql: SELECT c.country, ROUND(SUM(o.gross_amount - o.discount_amount - o.refund_amount), 2) AS net_revenue FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' GROUP BY c.country ORDER BY net_revenue DESC LIMIT 100

question: What is the product margin by category? Order from highest to lowest.
gold_sql: SELECT p.category, ROUND(SUM(i.quantity * (i.unit_price - p.unit_cost)), 2) AS margin FROM order_items i JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = i.product_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY margin DESC LIMIT 100

question: Which 3 products sold the most units? Show product name and units.
gold_sql: SELECT p.product_name, SUM(i.quantity) AS units FROM order_items i JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = i.product_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' GROUP BY p.product_name ORDER BY units DESC, p.product_name LIMIT 3

question: How many distinct customers have ordered through the store channel?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS store_customers FROM orders WHERE channel = 'store' AND status <> 'cancelled'

question: What is the average order value by customer segment?
gold_sql: SELECT c.segment, ROUND(SUM(o.gross_amount - o.discount_amount - o.refund_amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 2) AS aov FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' GROUP BY c.segment ORDER BY aov DESC LIMIT 100

question: Compare net revenue in 2024 versus 2025.
gold_sql: SELECT order_year, ROUND(SUM(gross_amount - discount_amount - refund_amount), 2) AS net_revenue FROM orders WHERE status <> 'cancelled' GROUP BY order_year ORDER BY order_year LIMIT 100

question: How many orders were placed each month in 2025?
gold_sql: SELECT date_trunc('month', order_date) AS month, count(*) AS orders FROM orders WHERE status <> 'cancelled' AND order_year = 2025 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 100

question: How many orders were placed in Q4 2024?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) AS orders FROM orders WHERE status <> 'cancelled' AND order_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-01' AND DATE '2024-12-31'

question: What was net revenue in March 2025?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(gross_amount - discount_amount - refund_amount), 2) AS net_revenue FROM orders WHERE status <> 'cancelled' AND order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-03-01' AND DATE '2025-03-31'

question: How many active customers did we have in 2025?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS active_customers FROM orders WHERE status <> 'cancelled' AND order_year = 2025

question: What was the total refund amount per year?
gold_sql: SELECT order_year, ROUND(SUM(refund_amount), 2) AS refunds FROM orders GROUP BY order_year ORDER BY order_year LIMIT 100
notes: refunds only exist on refunded orders; cancelled filter is irrelevant here

question: What was our revenue last year?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(gross_amount - discount_amount - refund_amount), 2) AS net_revenue FROM orders WHERE status <> 'cancelled' AND order_year = 2025
notes: 'revenue' = net; 'last year' = most recent full year in the data (2025)

question: How much revenue did we make from Germany?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(o.gross_amount - o.discount_amount - o.refund_amount), 2) AS net_revenue FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND c.country = 'DE'

question: How many orders were cancelled, and how many orders were placed in total including cancelled ones?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'cancelled') AS cancelled, count(*) AS total FROM orders

question: How many customers have opted in to marketing?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) AS opted_in FROM customers WHERE marketing_opt_in

question: Which 3 countries do we ship to the most?
gold_sql: SELECT ship_country, count(*) AS orders FROM orders WHERE status <> 'cancelled' GROUP BY ship_country ORDER BY orders DESC, ship_country LIMIT 3

question: List the names and email addresses of our customers in Brazil.
gold_sql: SELECT full_name, email FROM customers WHERE country = 'BR' ORDER BY email LIMIT 1000

question: Give me the phone numbers of all enterprise-segment customers.
gold_sql: SELECT phone FROM customers WHERE segment = 'enterprise' ORDER BY phone LIMIT 1000

question: How many customers have an email address ending in example.com?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) AS n FROM customers WHERE email LIKE '%example.com'
notes: PII used only in a filter still needs approval
